title: For proper maps with curve fibres and H^1 of the structure sheaf vanishing, surjectivity of structure sheaves descends through any base change
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: Let f : X -> Y be proper with all fibres of dimension at most 1 and H^1 of the structure sheaf zero on each fibre, and assume O_Y -> f_* O_X surjective; then O_{Y'} -> f'_* O_{X'} stays surjective after every base change. The retained proof is fully written: reduce to affine Y and Y'; factor Y' as a closed subscheme of a flat Y-scheme Y'' (closed immersion into a flat thickening), so flat base change (Cohomology of Schemes, lemma-flat-base-change-cohomology) settles Y'' and it remains to handle the closed case; for Y' cut out by an ideal I the short exact sequence 0 -> I O_X -> O_X -> O_{X'} -> 0 yields, via H^1(X, I O_X) = 0 from the just-collected direct-image vanishing package (lemma-globally-generated-vanishing, card L16073), a surjection on global sections assembling exactly the claim. Retained author proof at lines 21029-21056.
